newsitem.title: UK: UK M0 falls to s/adj 24.656 bln stg in latest week.
newsitem.headline: UK M0 falls to s/adj 24.656 bln stg in latest week.

text.p: The Bank of England said on Monday that seasonally adjusted narrow money supply fell to 24.656 billion stg in the week ending November 6 from 24.791 billion in the week ending October 30.
Notes and coins in circulation fell to a seasonally adjusted level of 24.456 billion stg from 24.463 billion stg the previous week.

The unadjusted level for M0 was 24.465 billion stg in the week ending November 6 compared with 24.651 billion stg the previous week. The unadjusted level for notes and coins in circulation was 24.265 billion stg compared with 24.323 billion stg the previous week.
